pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with sharp edge gradients; patches on the neck are larger and more elongated, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes near the shoulder and lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored interstitial space; exhibits tri-directional junction nodes and relatively uniform pathway thickness throughout the visible midsection.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine, dark mane along the neck exhibiting a low-amplitude, jagged geometric silhouette against the background.
